title: AI Background Remover
description: Remove image backgrounds automatically in seconds.
longDesc: Our advanced background removal tool leverages neural networks to identify and segment foreground elements, producing transparent PNGs with crisp details and smooth edges.

faqs.question: What image formats are supported?
faqs.answer: We support PNG, JPG, and WebP images up to 10MB in size.

articles.title: Why background removal matters
articles.content: Clean cutouts are essential for commercial product photography, web layouts, and corporate profiles.
